svg.title: Two trivial steps, and one hidden assumption
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Two trivial steps, and one hidden assumption” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Twelve points assigned to three cross-marked centres with dashed Voronoi boundaries, then the same points with the centres arrowed to their group means and ghosts left where they were, looped back by a curved repeat arrow annotated inertia 1200.2 to 566.9, beside three crossed-out failure panels for moon-shaped, anisotropic and unequal-variance data with adjusted Rand scores of 0.2549, 0.8995 and 0.8265 and their density- or mixture-model fixes, and a bottom pair showing the worse silhouette belongs to the better clustering.
